description: Subtitle lint: SRT and WebVTT overlaps, duration, reading speed, line length — Parses an SRT or WebVTT file (up to 400000 characters, 4000 cues) and checks every cue for an agent about to deliver or burn in captions: end after start, overlaps and out-of-order cues, minimum gap, minimum and maximum duration, lines per cue, characters per line and characters per second (markup tags are not counted). Rules come from a named profile (netflix-en-adult, netflix-en-children, values

custom.description: Your own rules; these override profile values.

format.description: Default: vtt if the text starts with WEBVTT, else srt.

frameRate.description: Needed to turn a minimum gap in frames into milliseconds.

profile.description: netflix-en-adult: 42 chars/line, 2 lines, 20 cps, 5/6 s to 7 s, 2-frame gap. netflix-en-children: same at 17 cps.

name: subtitle-lint
